title: A universal joint critical SK equilibrium and quench autocorrelation law
exact_target: At SK critical $\beta =1$, do Gaussian and Rademacher couplings yield the same joint limiting continuous law for the precisely rescaled equilibrium autocorrelation $A_n(t)$ and quench autocorrelation $B_n(s,t)$, on positive-time compact sets? Ask for positive-time entrance densities $h_s$ selected by Gaussian dynamics, $h_{s+t}=S_t$ $h_s$, $h_s$ $Pi\to \delta _0$ as $s\downarrow 0$, $h_s\to 1$ in L1 as s$\to$infinity, and $B(s,t)\to A(t)$ locally uniformly in probability as waiting time s$\to$infinity.
